notes: Real browser (Claude-in-Chrome) investigation, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked via cached fetch, only a generic User-agent:* block list, none of it covers /catalog/category/). Fully traversed the live DECOR mega-menu tree (Mirrors, Wall Art, Wall Decor, Decorative Accents plus its 8 sub-items: All Decorative Accents/Plinths & Sculptures/Objects/Books/Vessels/Boxes/Trays & Troughs/Greenery/Candles & Hurricanes, Cabinet Hardware, Bar, Drapery & Hardware, Pillows, Throws, In Stock sub-menu, Sale sub-menu, RH Estates Decor sub-menu) and the top-level SALE mega-menu (mirrors the 11 main categories only) and the hamburger/global nav (World/Estates/Interiors/Places/Spaces/Services) - no Christmas, Halloween, Diwali, Holiday, Festive, or any other seasonal/holiday node exists anywhere in current live navigation. Also checked Living mega-menu (furniture only, no holiday). Web search (Google) surfaced one historical RH URL, 'All Holiday Decor' cat5080006, in three URL forms (/catalog/category/products.jsp/cat5080006, /catalog/category/collections.jsp/cat5080006, /catalog/category/sale-products.jsp?categoryId=cat5080006); all three were opened directly in a real browser session (full page load, waited 6-14s each, verified via accessibility-tree read_page and get_page_text) and every one rendered a completely empty <main> region (header/footer render fine) - i.e. the category is orphaned/discontinued and not part of the current live catalog, so no row was created from it. Site search (rh.com/us/en/search/results.jsp?Ntt=christmas and Ntt=holiday) also rendered an empty result region, consistent with the category being gone rather than proving absence on its own - the nav traversal is the primary evidence. RH's catalog is furniture/lighting/decor-forward luxury home furnishings with no dedicated seasonal/holiday merchandising in the current site taxonomy.
